version.value: Orchestral ballet; this 1960 performance uses the separately published 1943 revision of the final Sacrificial Dance.
version.note: Not a literal restoration of the 1913 performance. Part I stage notes use shared scoring features of the later corrected Boosey/Dover score; a detailed Part II stage map is withheld because the matching 1943 finale score was not inspected.
